name: Carla Eldorl
source:
Human Sacred Enforcer

A paladin of the Lasfarr Church, Andal denomination. A sacred enforcer of the church responsible for special missions. (Her brief primarily covers the pacification of demons and heretics in the outer reaches of Church territory and lands not under the sway of the Church's influence. It's also the department which the Church assigns its troublemakers to.) 

She's known Gilbert from childhood as they both attended the same monastery. She has a strong sense of justice coupled with an assertive character and a blunt personality. She's extremely pretty and turns heads where she goes, but her personality has disappointed many a suitor.

Despite being a paladin, she has a contract with a demon and the power she gains from it is embedded in the sword "Vigenritt" which she wields. Although a practitioner of holy magic, she's not good with healing spells.

[Spoiler] Although a childhood friend of Gil and who's had a crush on him since young, she did not see him again after he ran away from the monastery until he had become a full-fledged Demonslayer and herself a fully qualified paladin. Although she worked alongside him on a professional basis, he would use every opportunity to run away from her after the contract ended and she would end up pursuing him in tandem with her duties.

She has two missions on Regulus island: the first one is to identify the origin of the mysterious horn left behind by one of her fellow paladins who went missing on the island not long before she arrived. The second one is to apprehend the culprit behind a series of child abductions on the Continent, suspected of fleeing to Regulus island after slipping through the blockade laid by the Lasfarr church during the last engagement. 

She derives immense pleasure from being verbally abused by Gil during sex, which he uses as an opportunity to sexually train her to his liking. She keeps many of the old behavioural habits she had when both Gil and her were children, which annoys Gil to the extent he will take it out on her during their sexual trysts. [/Spoiler]
